items.story:

The partnership, announced on Tuesday, brings together Technip Energies, Airbus, Safran, and Tereos to form Rebound, a joint venture that will focus on producing Alcohol-to-Jet SAF. The project is also part of a broader trend towards greater cooperation between companies and governments on sustainability issues. As the world continues to grapple with the challenges of climate change, collaborations like this one are likely to become increasingly important.

As the Rebound joint venture moves forward, there are still several challenges to be overcome.
